sections.title: Detroit Industry Specializations
sections.description: Deep expertise in Detroit's key industry verticals.

blocks.heading: Automotive and Mobility (Detroit's AI Renaissance)
paragraphs: Ford Motor Company (Dearborn HQ), General Motors (Detroit HQ), and Stellantis (Auburn Hills HQ) are each investing billions in AI for vehicle software, manufacturing automation, and connected vehicle services. Detroit's AI market is being reshaped by three forces simultaneously:

Software-defined vehicles: As vehicles become software platforms, Detroit's OEMs need AI capabilities for in-vehicle personalization, predictive maintenance alerts, driver behavior analytics, and over-the-air update optimization. The AI for software-defined vehicles sits in the commercial software layer — ClickMasters builds commercial AI applications for vehicle software platforms.

Manufacturing AI: Detroit's automotive manufacturing plants are among the most sophisticated manufacturing environments in the world. Computer vision for component inspection (door panels, engine components, body-in-white quality), predictive maintenance from equipment sensor data, and robotic programming AI are specific ClickMasters capabilities for Detroit's Tier 1 and Tier 2 suppliers.

Supply chain intelligence: The global automotive supply chain — disrupted dramatically by the 2021–2022 semiconductor shortage — has created enormous demand for supply chain disruption prediction, supplier risk scoring, and multi-tier supply chain visibility AI.

blocks.heading: Automotive Supplier Ecosystem
paragraphs: Michigan's Tier 1 and Tier 2 suppliers — Magna International (Aurora, ON HQ but major Michigan operations), Lear Corporation (Southfield, MI HQ), BorgWarner (Auburn Hills HQ), Gentex Corporation (Zeeland MI), Aptiv (Dublin HQ, major Michigan presence) — constitute one of the world's most sophisticated industrial supplier communities. AI for quality control, supply chain management, and manufacturing operations for the OEM supplier ecosystem.

blocks.heading: Healthcare
paragraphs: Henry Ford Health System (Detroit HQ, one of the US's most respected integrated health systems), Beaumont Health, and Detroit Medical Center. HIPAA-compliant clinical AI for Detroit's health systems.

blocks.heading: Financial Services
paragraphs: Ally Financial (Detroit HQ, one of the US's largest digital banks and auto lenders), and Detroit's financial services community. Auto finance analytics, credit risk, and consumer banking AI.

sections.title: Automotive AI Technical Context
sections.description: Detroit's automotive AI requires specific technical understanding.

blocks.heading: AUTOSAR and Automotive Software Standards
paragraphs: ClickMasters builds commercial AI applications for the software layers above AUTOSAR — fleet analytics, connected vehicle data platforms, and OEM customer-facing applications — rather than AUTOSAR-embedded automotive control systems, which are specialized automotive software domains.

blocks.heading: CAN Bus and Vehicle Telemetry
paragraphs: Connected vehicle AI uses CAN bus data, OBD-II diagnostic data, and telematics streams. ClickMasters designs ML that processes automotive telemetry data for fleet analytics, driver scoring, and predictive maintenance applications.

blocks.heading: ISO 26262 and ASPICE Context
paragraphs: Safety-critical automotive AI has specific process requirements under ISO 26262 (functional safety) and ASPICE (Automotive SPICE process assessment). ClickMasters provides technical documentation context appropriate to automotive development processes for relevant applications.
